run_oneformer_universal_segmentation: run OneFormerForUniversalSegmentation to perform semantic, instance, and panoptic image segmentation on input images
build_oneformer_model: build a OneFormerModel with pixel-level encoder, transformer decoder, and task encoder for universal segmentation
train_oneformer_with_losses: train OneFormer using Hungarian matcher, cross-entropy, dice, mask, and contrastive losses with auxiliary predictions
encode_text_for_contrastive_loss: encode text inputs through OneFormerTextMapper to produce text queries for query-text contrastive training
sample_deformable_attention_features: sample multi-scale deformable attention features from backbone outputs using bilinear grid sampling
